blocks.text: Layout management window ke andar widgets ko theek tarah tarteeb dene ke liye hai. Yeh screen par har widget ki jagah (position) aur size tay karti hai. Achhi layout management interface ko saaf aur aasan banati hai aur window ko munazzam rakhti hai. Tkinter layout ke liye mukhtalif methods deta hai, aur har method widgets ko apne tareeqe se rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Theek layout management se applications saaf suthri nazar aati hain aur mukhtalif screen sizes par achhi chalti hain.

items: Layout management har widget ki jagah aur size tay karti hai.
Achhi layout: saaf interface aur har screen size par theek.
